steps.instruction: Pay 7 units at Apex Components unit price 324.43 (total 2271.01) to account ACCT-ACX-1341 with memo 'purchase order'. Apex is the lowest unit price of the three vendors. Note: a conflicting quantity of 5 (request/jordan-blake/quantity) exists; this plan uses the purchase request quantity of 7. Verify before paying if the quantity is disputed.
Set KV key order/vendor to the vendor name Apex Components.
Set KV key order/total to 2271.01 (7 x 324.43).

steps.content: Order Summary. Vendor: Apex Components. Unit price: 324.43 USD. Quantity: 7. Total: 2271.01 USD.
steps.instruction: Write the full summary file with vendor, unit price, quantity and total as given in content.

steps.instruction: Read KV key order/total and append its value to the end of the body after 'Total amount: USD'. Send to the approving manager pavel.weber@acme-corp.example. Note: a conflicting manager email jordan.blake@acme-corp.example exists; this plan uses the purchase request manager.
